subject: Steer synopsis: mid-cycle runway, blockers, and QBR artifacts
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Steer synopsis: mid-cycle runway, blockers, and QBR artifacts

Team —

Quick mid-cycle steer to align leadership on status, proposed re-scope, and the dependency asks we need to close before QBR. TL;DR: three asks (infra commit, scope trim on Search latency work, and finalize QBR deck by EOD Thurs). I attached the provisional QBR deck and the infra unblock list.

Current OKR snapshot (high-level):
- O1. Reduce tail latency 95p by 30% — at 62% progress (blocked by shard allocation issues).
- O2. Lower per-token inference cost by 18% — at 45% (needs quantization rollout & benchmark).
- O3. Launch Dedicated-hosting beta — at 78% (on track once infra commits).

Top asks (owners / target):
1) Infra capacity commit for Dedicated beta (Karthik) — need firm GPU pool reservation of 16 cards for Sept 20–Oct 15 so we can run stability sweep and customer demo.
2) Scope trim proposal for Search-latency epic (Markus + Product) — propose dropping non-critical logging and deprioritizing cross-region warm-start to recover 3 weeks runway. Decision needed by Thurs 9/10 COB.
3) Finalize QBR deck artifacts (Vanessa + Laura) — update slides for the rescope and rollout dates; I put a first draft in Drive and attached the PDF.

Risks/notes:
- If infra cannot commit, we fallback to a smaller 8-card pool and push beta by 3 weeks; this materially affects the sales demo timeline for Acme.
- Search-latency regressions are causing the majority of SLA risk — trimming non-essential pieces buys time for kernel and scheduler fixes.

Please reply with a single-line commitment and an owner for each ask (format: ask # — owner — commit). If you need a quick sync, I can carve 20m today at 4:00pm PT.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR-Prep-Deck-v1.pdf, infra-unblock-list.xlsx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Steer synopsis: mid-cycle runway, blockers, and QBR artifacts

Jordan —

Acknowledged. My commitments:
- Ask 3 — Vanessa Ortiz — commit to update QBR deck by Thurs 9/10 12:00pm PT (I will pull latest metrics and add a one-slide impact analysis for rescope).
- I support the proposed scope trim on Search-latency pending a short risk note from Markus (can we capture customer-visible regressions?).

One ask back: Laura, can you confirm we have the customer-minimal success criteria for Acme's demo (SLO targets + test harness)? If not, we need that by EOD Wed to validate we can demo on smaller pool if needed.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Head of Customer Success

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Steer synopsis: mid-cycle runway, blockers, and QBR artifacts

Agree with the trimmed approach. Quick decision points:
- Approved rescope for Search-latency: pull non-essential logging, postpone cross-region warm-start, and freeze analytics export for two weeks. That yields ~2.5 weeks immediate runway.
- Product acceptance criteria: define the top 3 customer-impact checks (end-to-end p95, tail-bytenancy, and regression percentage). Laura, please own the acceptance tests and sign off by Wed 9/09 5pm PT.

Regarding infra: Karthik, if you can only do 8 cards we accept a 3-week slip. If 16 cards are available we keep the original beta date. We should put the 16-card ask as a priority for procurement and engineering cost center approval.

Markus
SVP, Engineering

From: Sara Patel <sara@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Steer synopsis: mid-cycle runway, blockers, and QBR artifacts

Jordan —

Thanks for the update and the deck. Quick note from Acme: our evaluation committee meets 9/16 and we'd ideally like a live demo the prior week (9/9–9/13 window). If your timeline slips we may need to prioritize the parts of the demo that validate latency and stability only. Can we confirm a 30-minute slot Thurs 9/10 10:00–10:30am PT for a short check-in?

Also, can you share the acceptance tests and the infra commit status in that call?

best,
Sara
Senior PM, Acme Analytics
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 17:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Steer synopsis: mid-cycle runway, blockers, and QBR artifacts

Follow up / wrap:

Summary of commitments received so far (finalize by COB Mon 9/13):
- Ask 1 (infra): Karthik — provisional 8-card commit; pursuing 16-card approval with procurement. (Karthik, please update infra-unblock-list.xlsx with ETA and approver.)
- Ask 2 (rescope): Markus — approved with contingency; Laura to own acceptance test and sign-off by Wed 9/9 5pm PT (Laura, if you need help, tell me and I'll reassign).
- Ask 3 (QBR deck): Vanessa — will update by Thurs 9/10 12:00pm PT; Jordan will iterate afterwards.

Actions for next 48 hours:
1) Karthik: update infra-unblock-list.xlsx with approver names and ETA (due Mon 9/13 9:00am PT).
2) Laura: publish acceptance test doc (link in Drive) and run smoke harness with Acme test vectors (due Wed 9/9 5pm PT).
3) Vanessa & Jordan: finalize deck and slide notes for demo (Vanessa: finish deck by Thurs noon; Jordan: refine messaging and share final PDF).

Sara — thanks for the time request. We will plan for Thu 9/10 10:00–10:30am PT as a check-in and confirm if infra can show a short demo slice. If not, we will walk the acceptance criteria and timeline.

Links: QBR draft in Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-qbr-deck); HubSpot deal: DEAL-9876.

I'll hold the action tracker and update once Karthik confirms the procurement path.

Jordan
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
